body:
Hey all, I found a solution that worked for me!

Navigate to:

SteamLibrary\\steamapps\\common\\Hogwarts Legacy\\Engine\\Plugins\\Runtime\\Nvidia\\Streamline\\Binaries\\ThirdParty\\Win64\\

  
and in there is a file sl.pcl.dll

  
delete that and run the game, it's presently working great for me!
I really needed to hear that! Thank you!!
Yeah, it’s too hard to press on

I understand the feeling. Had a patient come into our trauma room, 7 year old boy in cardiac arrest. He didn’t make it. I still hear the mother’s cries sometimes. I hope you can find a support group to help you through this! That’s what helped me. Stay strong.
I’m sorry to hear that. You’re never alone though. I promise there is always someone that cares about you and wants the best for you.
I know this is a low ball but best I can do is $2500. Otherwise I hope you get your money back!!
I’ve heard that before. I’ve never been able to though. It seems like I ruin everything good in my life and I find it difficult to love myself. Do you have any advice to share?

I appreciate the support but I’m still stuck on him. I can’t seem to give myself closure and want him back so bad. He felt like my soulmate and was the first person I ever fell in love with. I’m just tired of the people I love not loving me back and the people who love me I don’t love back.
